verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing app. Such a product could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no product CLI for scripting or agent-driven control. The command-line items do not count: Homebrew install/upgrade and shasum verification are host-platform tools. `swift run -c release SillHost` (optionally with `--synthetic`) is a from-source developer way to run the streaming host, not a CLI for operating Sill. No llms.txt or API surface was found either.
